# IWMMD 1.3.1

IWMMD 1.3.1 fixes Discord delivery failures and gives Discord notifications a richer card layout.

## Discord fixes

- Discord webhooks no longer send empty `username` or `avatar_url` fields. Discord rejects an empty username with HTTP 400.
- Discord API error responses are included in delivery errors, so channel tests show the actual validation message instead of only `HTTP 400`.
- Discord connection errors redact the webhook token.
- The Channels page now shows the delivery detail when a test fails.

## Richer Discord notifications

- Structured embed fields for status, domain, expiry date, alert rule, incident type, and event time.
- Tone-aware accent colors for delivery tests, expiry alerts, open incidents, and recovered incidents.
- Author label, footer timestamp, and a link button back to the domain.
- Optional custom display name and avatar are still supported.

## Upgrade from 1.3.0

There is no database migration. Stop IWMMD, replace the container image or binary, and start it again.

Existing Discord channels work without changes. Channels without a custom display name will start delivering again.

Container users:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.1
```

Set `IWMMD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.1` in `.env` to pin the release.

Binary users:

```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/MrWeez/iwmmd/releases/download/v1.3.1/iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_amd64/iwmmd /usr/local/bin/iwmmd
iwmmd version
```

Replace `amd64` with `arm64` on ARM servers.

## Release assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_amd64` | Raw static binary for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_arm64` | Raw static binary for ARM64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.1_linux_arm64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for ARM64 Linux |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for all binary assets |

Verify downloaded assets:

```sh
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing checksums.txt
```

## Container image

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.1
```

Published image tags: `1.3.1`, `1.3`, `1`, `latest`, and `sha-<commit>`.
